recipes.title: Success burst
recipes.notes: Lead with the hero; halo and caption follow.

recipes.notes: Typography first, supporting elements later.

recipes.notes: Intentional overshoot and short settle.

recipes.notes: Scripted press-release, not automatic interaction state wiring.

recipes.notes: Geometry must correspond to provided artboard.

recipes.title: Navigation swap
recipes.notes: Incoming content overlaps outgoing exit.

recipes.title: Hero parallax

recipes.title: Input focus
recipes.notes: Animation does not replace accessible focus behavior.

recipes.title: Typographic echo

recipes.title: Word spotlight
recipes.notes: Single strong keyword contrasts supporting sentence.

recipes.title: Numeral emphasis
recipes.notes: Visual metric reveal; not a changing numeric value.

recipes.notes: Quote readable before attribution.

recipes.title: Letterpress impact
recipes.notes: A controlled elastic impact instead of random shakes.

recipes.title: Branded end card
recipes.notes: Stable final hold for meaningful brand recall.

recipes.title: Staggered KPI dashboard
recipes.notes: Three pre-existing metric widgets with readable cadence.

recipes.title: Magazine cover staging
recipes.notes: Fixed-layout design with soft camera-like settle.

recipes.title: Brand mark bloom
recipes.notes: Center first, peripheral bloom later.

recipes.title: Glossy panel reveal
recipes.notes: Requires glass-like artwork supplied by visual layer.

recipes.title: Orbiting product accent

recipes.title: Gallery panel takeover
recipes.notes: Panel geometry must be laid out independently.

recipes.title: Vertical gallery reveal

recipes.title: Feature tour

recipes.title: Before after comparison
recipes.notes: Switches prebuilt visual samples, not a computed image morph.

recipes.title: Metallic glint reveal
recipes.notes: Glint shape must be properly clipped to product; opacity lanes join exactly.
